before: if (~g_en | OTP | latch_state | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
mutants.description: Over-temperature during soft start is treated as a recoverable start-up stress and sent through the S_HICCUP cool-down instead of straight to S_OFF
mutants.reason: If OTP rises while the FSM is in S_SS, state_out goes to S_HICCUP and hiccup_active pulses (a strike gets counted) before the FSM reaches S_OFF. It should go straight to S_OFF with hiccup_active staying low.

before: if (~g_en | OTP | latch_state | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
after: if (~spi_enable | OTP | latch_state | UVLO | latch_assert) begin
mutants.description: In S_SS only a host disable over SPI is checked: turning off the physical switch during soft start gates en but leaves the FSM ramping in S_SS
mutants.reason: If en_SW falls while in S_SS with spi_enable high, en drops but state_out stays S_SS and ss_active stays high instead of going to S_OFF. The FSM then moves on to S_RUN when SS_done arrives.

before: if (~g_en | latch_state | OTP | latch_assert | UVLO) begin
after: if (~spi_enable | latch_state | OTP | latch_assert | UVLO) begin
mutants.description: In S_HICCUP only a host disable over SPI is checked: turning off the physical switch during the cool-down does not send the FSM to S_OFF
mutants.reason: If en_SW falls during S_HICCUP with spi_enable high, the FSM stays in S_HICCUP instead of going to S_OFF, and on hiccup_done it retries into S_SS (state_out S_SS, ss_active high) while the switch is still off.

before: if (~g_en | latch_state | OTP | latch_assert | UVLO) begin
mutants.description: Losing the enable during the cool-down only holds off the retry: the FSM waits in S_HICCUP until it is re-enabled instead of going to S_OFF
mutants.reason: If en_SW or spi_enable falls in S_HICCUP, state_out stays S_HICCUP and hiccup_active stays high instead of going to S_OFF. When the converter is re-enabled after hiccup_done, it retries straight into S_SS from S_HICCUP.

before: if (~g_en | latch_state | OTP | latch_assert | UVLO) begin
mutants.description: Input undervoltage during the cool-down is treated as extending the cool-down: the FSM stays in S_HICCUP until UVLO clears instead of going to S_OFF
mutants.reason: If UVLO rises in S_HICCUP, state_out stays S_HICCUP and hiccup_active stays high instead of going to S_OFF. Once UVLO clears after hiccup_done, the FSM retries into S_SS directly from S_HICCUP.
